scientific_hypothesis: Removing periodicity and grading constraints allows the optimizer to find layer thickness combinations that periodic or chirped stacks cannot achieve, potentially discovering non-intuitive thickness sequences that better separate the UV reflection and SWIR transmission bands.
expected_advantages: No structural assumptions limit the search space
L27 demonstrates global optimization finds coatings meeting multiple spectral requirements
May discover thickness patterns that periodic designs miss
known_risks: Higher-dimensional optimization (28 variables) may converge slowly
Risk of overfitting to specific wavelength points rather than bands
L26 notes HfO2 defect formation may limit practical performance regardless of optimization
expected_observations: If the non-periodic hypothesis holds, best_target_score should exceed both route_01 and route_02, and thicknesses_nm should show no periodic or monotonic pattern
If the non-periodic hypothesis fails, best_target_score will converge to values similar to route_01 and thicknesses_nm will self-organize into near-periodic patterns despite no constraint
valid_candidates may be lower (5-10 per round) due to higher-dimensional search space
tightest_margin should not decrease across rounds if the optimizer finds robust solutions
stop_conditions: If best_target_score improves by less than 1e-3 against the historical best for two consecutive rounds, treat the axis as exhausted, stop and keep the current best
If valid_candidates falls below 3 for three consecutive rounds, reduce optimization dimensionality by grouping adjacent layers and continue for one more round before stopping
